title: Monster Speed V3 Step 1 — quarantine legacy app.py workflow fanout

desired_active_runs: CFB Top Picks Nav Step 1 Dropdown

root_cause: Frozen product workflows retained app.py in pull_request/push path filters. Any additive app entrypoint/router activation therefore woke dozens of unrelated historical CFB/NFL/Passing-Yards lanes, many of which were stale and failed while consuming runners.
patch: Remove app.py only from the automatic trigger blocks of the 51 workflows proven to have fanned out on the reference main commit. Preserve every workflow file, manual/product-specific trigger, job body, frozen contract and historical evidence. Add a permanent 51-workflow guard.
